findings.label: Chevron tap from the compact bar collapses the details it just opened
findings.detail: enterAddMode() ends with setDescExpanded(true), and form.addEventListener('focusin', () => enterAddMode()) fires before the chevron's click handler. On engines that focus a <button> on tap (Chromium desktop and Android), tapping the chevron in the compact state runs focusin -> enterAddMode -> details expanded, then click -> open = !isDescExpanded() = false -> details collapsed and descDismissed = true for the rest of the session. Net effect: the control whose label read 'Dodaj opis (opcjonalnie)' enters add mode with the description shut, which contradicts requirement 1 (details open on entering add mode). iOS Safari does not focus buttons on tap, so the behaviour is engine-dependent.
findings.suggestion: Stop deriving the chevron's intent from post-entry DOM state. Pass the focus origin into entry, e.g. form.addEventListener('focusin', e => enterAddMode({ fromToggle: e.target === toggle })) and skip setDescExpanded(true) for that entry so the click handler is the one that opens the row; or snapshot isDescExpanded()/isAddMode() on pointerdown/mousedown on the toggle and use the snapshot in the click handler.

findings.label: Harness matrix is missing plan entry E3 (chevron from the compact state)
findings.detail: Section 5(d) only exercises the chevron from inside add mode ('Chevron tapped in add mode'). The compact -> chevron-tap path, listed as E3 in the plan, is never asserted, which is why finding 1 went unobserved on the very engine the harness runs (Chromium/Edge with isMobile+hasTouch).
findings.suggestion: Add a row starting from S1: tap #quickAddToggle and assert body.quick-add-active present, form.is-expanded true, toggle aria-expanded="true", the label switched to 'Ukryj opis', descDismissed not latched (leaving and re-entering still opens details) and #quickAddComments focused.

findings.label: leaderboard.html and wiadomosci.html still load tab-bar-functions.js?v=16
findings.detail: Six of the eight pages loading the shared script were bumped to ?v=17 (activity, formularz, home, recipients, rezerwacje, ustawienia). leaderboard.html:1509 and wiadomosci.html:840 remain at ?v=16, so their 'Dodaj' tab navigates without ?add=1 until the cached script is revalidated (form opens normally, just without the composer auto-opening). Correctly deferred - both are on this task's do-not-edit list - and explicitly listed in the verification doc as a carry-over.
findings.suggestion: Merge step: bump both to ?v=17. wiadomosci.html is already modified in this working tree by the chat-noscroll task, so the bump is a one-line addition there.

findings.label: iOS close path loses the focus hand-off to #myPresentsHeading
findings.detail: exitAddMode gates both the blur and the heading focus on 'document.activeElement is inside the form'. On iOS Safari a tap on the X (or on the submit '+') blurs the focused input before the click, so activeElement is <body>, inForm is false and focus is never parked on #myPresentsHeading - screen-reader reading position drops to the top of the document. The keyboard still closes (the platform did it) and close/Escape remain reachable, so the 'always a way out' requirement still holds.
findings.suggestion: Record whether focus was inside the form at pointerdown on #quickAddClose / #quickAddBtn, or unconditionally focus #myPresentsHeading for the 'close', 'escape' and 'added' reasons while keeping the blur conditional.
